scenes.label: Meet the team
scenes.title: At the gate
scenes.caption: The festival gate team needs a readable list of forty-two registrations. One shared laptop holds the working copy. Having a file somewhere is not enough if the right person cannot use it when visitors arrive.
scenes.dialogue: Will the list still be usable after a failure?

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.title: The empty file
scenes.caption: At ten thirty, the working file becomes empty. Sync copies that empty state. A duplicate on the same failed laptop may be unavailable too. A separate version from ten o clock still contains the expected registrations.
scenes.dialogue: The newest copy may contain the same damage.

scenes.label: How it works
scenes.title: Recoverable copies
scenes.caption: Separate backups can survive a device failure. Version history can recover a state before corruption. A restoration test checks that the contents are readable, complete and accessible. Preserve the original and restore a practice duplicate to a new folder.
scenes.dialogue: Test restoration, not just the backup icon.

scenes.label: Your decision
scenes.title: Your decision
scenes.caption: The corruption began at ten thirty. Compare the unavailable local duplicate, the newest empty synced file and the separate earlier version. Choose the first recovery point to test.
scenes.dialogue: Which copy can give us a usable independent fallback?

scenes.label: What changes
scenes.title: Test the restore
scenes.caption: The team restores the separate earlier version to a new folder. It checks the expected forty-two records and tests access with the gate account. The original remains untouched and the restoration result is recorded.
scenes.dialogue: Now we have evidence that recovery worked.

scenes.label: Enter the lab
scenes.title: Enter the lab
scenes.caption: The team also uses trusted updates, individual accounts and a screen lock. These controls address different risks. In the lab, repair the device plan, restore a fictional file and decide how to verify a different recovery case.
scenes.dialogue: Protect the device and rehearse the fallback.
